## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. VXX falling (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -18.13%) BELOW TREND and broad sector breadth argue for strength, while HYG/LQD flagged as CREDIT STRESS ↓ (score: -2) creates a conflicting signal.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -18.13%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling. Reflation/commodity impulse: CPER (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.20%) ABOVE TREND ↑ rising, offset by credit tension signalled in HYG/LQD (Credit Spread 0.7294, 1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.55%) → flat / CORRECTION.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-cautious: SPY (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +0.83%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -1.88%) RECOVERY leave Stocks vs Bonds flat (SPY/TLT CORRECTION). Dollar modestly firmer: Dollar Strength (Level 27.05) 1W: +0.41% → flat / RECOVERY.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Tech and Energy showing relative strength but mixed leadership: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +1.76%) and XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +0.26%), while Financials lag in CORRECTION: XLF (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +3.83%). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. US vs Global?  
US equities steady: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.32% | 1M: +0.83%), Europe firm: VGK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.87% | 1M: +3.94%) and EM leading on a reflation bid: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +2.48%). China patchy: FXI RECOVERY (1W: +0.10% | 1M: -1.11%).

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation waning: IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -0.52% | 1M: -3.34%) and ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -4.44% | 1M: -2.27%) weak; small caps showing short-term pullback: IWM CORRECTION (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +0.04%). Overall risk-on flows uneven.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Industrial/reflation assets strong: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.20%) and DBB ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.07% | 1M: +7.58%) ↑ rising. Precious metals mixed: SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +34.70%) while GLD in CORRECTION (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +2.84%).

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy ETFs generally firmer: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +0.26%) while liquid oil proxy BNO BELOW TREND (1W: -0.28% | 1M: -2.23%) → flat; natural gas bounce: UNG RECOVERY (1W: +10.72% | 1M: -10.93%). Net: commodity-driven reflation remains a tailwind but dispersion is high.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: VXX falling (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -18.13%) BELOW TREND and CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.20%). MAJOR Divergence: XLF (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +3.83%) CORRECTION and TLT (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -1.88%) RECOVERY create cross-asset mismatches that suppress a clear risk-on call.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor commodity/reflation exposures and EM upside: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.20%) and EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.61% | 1M: +2.48%) showing strength. Reduce exposure to speculative/late-cycle small caps: IWM CORRECTION (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +0.04%) and ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -4.44% | 1M: -2.27%); bonds neutral (TLT RECOVERY).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.20%), SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +34.70%), XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +0.26%). BEARISH: XLF CORRECTION (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +3.83%), IWM CORRECTION (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +0.04%), ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -4.44% | 1M: -2.27%).

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.51% | 1M: +9.20%) and SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +34.70%) as reflation signals. BEARISH: GLD CORRECTION (1W: -2.29% | 1M: +2.84%) and URA BELOW TREND (1W: -7.30% | 1M: -5.45%) on rotation away from defensives in some cycles.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~26.28 (1W: -3.03% | 1M: -18.03%) BELOW TREND = complacency threshold to watch; HYG/LQD cross ~0.73 (Credit Spread 0.7294, 1W: -0.13% | 1M: +0.55%) → flat / CORRECTION for credit health. XLK/XLF ratio 2.6352 (1W: +0.08% | 1M: -2.85%) → flat as a tech vs financial pivot metric to monitor.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, but conflicting signals from falling VXX (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -18.13%) BELOW TREND and HYG/LQD flagged CREDIT STRESS ↓. Commodities and EM (CPER ABOVE TREND, EEM ABOVE TREND) showing strength while XLF and bond/TLT divergences are the key risks to monitor.
